text: Integrate ERC-8004 trust signals for agent collaboration
description: BONUS FEATURE: Implement trust-based agent selection and collaboration. Agent should read ERC-8004 reputation scores, refuse low-trust collaborators, update reputation after task completion, and participate in trust networks. Enables secure multi-agent coordination based on verifiable track records.

status.comment: Cancelled 24 July 2026: hackathon bonus-scoring feature without validating feedback or a current collaboration requirement. Aimparency should not implement speculative trust infrastructure. Reconsider only for a real multi-agent exchange where ERC-8004 signals are demanded.
